title: TARA Artifact Schema
description: Schema for Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment records, extending artifact-base.schema.json. A TARA record in this corpus is a corpus-local simplified threat-and-risk analysis. It is NOT an ISO/SAE 21434 work product, it has NOT been reviewed or approved by any cybersecurity or functional-safety authority, and it asserts no compliance with ISO/SAE 21434, ISO 26262 or any other standard. Every threat that rests on a code fact must carry source_refs; every threat that is a project judgement must declare origin 'synthetic'.

item_under_analysis.description: The item (product, ECU, subsystem or software element) this analysis covers

scope_included.description: Interfaces, modules or data flows explicitly inside the analysis boundary

scope_basis.description: How the scope boundary was drawn and what evidence supports it

profile_relationship.description: Statement of the relationship between this TARA and the as_is / synthetic_reference corpus profiles, including who owns and who accepts the residual risk

method_name.description: Name of the analysis method actually applied

is_iso_21434_tara.description: Machine-enforced: a record in this corpus may never declare itself an ISO/SAE 21434 TARA. The corpus-local method is explicitly not that process.

method_description.description: Description of the steps actually performed

limitations.description: Explicit, enumerated limitations of this analysis: what was not done, what is unknown, and what must not be inferred from it

assets_or_entry_points.description: Assets and externally reachable entry points of the item

asset_id.description: Stable identifier for the asset or entry point

location.description: File, module or interface location of the asset

interface.description: Communication or access interface the asset is exposed on

evidence_basis.description: Whether the existence of this asset was read out of the pinned source or assumed by the hypothetical project

exposure.description: Who or what can reach this asset and over which boundary

source_refs.description: Source anchors proving the asset exists at the stated location. Required for every evidence_basis='source_observed' asset.

threats.description: Identified threats against the assets. Each threat must state its origin: a threat evidenced in the pinned source, a threat that is a hypothetical-project judgement, or a threat that is derived from a threat scenario stated in the relevant standard.

attack_vector.description: How an attacker would reach the target

impact.description: Consequence if the threat is realised, bounded by what is actually reachable in the code

affected_safety_goals_or_requirements.description: Safety goals or requirements in this corpus whose assurance could be undermined by the threat

likelihood_impact_reasoning.description: Explicit reasoning, and the limits of that reasoning, for the assigned rating

residual_risk.description: The residual exposure grade of this threat AFTER its listed mitigations. This is the corpus's own three-value threat grading scale and it is local to threats[]. The same key name appears on four other field families in this corpus with four different value kinds - free prose on a FMEA failure mode, free prose on a coupling or interference category, and a validity-limitation statement on a test measure's oracle_detail - so this enum is declared here to keep the one place where the word is a vocabulary from silently accepting prose. not_rated means the threat was not graded; it is not a grade and carries no claim that the exposure is low.

origin.description: source_observed = the exposure is read directly out of the pinned source. synthetic = a hypothetical-project judgement that was NOT observed in the pinned source.

observed_in_pinned_source.description: True only when the exposure was read directly out of the pinned foxBMS source at commit 308028fb.

source_refs.description: Source anchors for the code facts this threat rests on. Required when origin is source_observed.

honest_unknowns.description: What is genuinely unknown about this threat and must not be asserted

mitigations.description: Mitigations, whether present in the pinned source or forward-engineered for the hypothetical project

mechanism.description: Concrete mechanism by which the mitigation acts, or the concrete mechanism that is missing

status.description: Whether the mitigation exists in the pinned foxBMS source or is a forward-engineered requirement of the hypothetical project

verification_status.description: not_verified = no verification evidence exists in this corpus. verified_by_inspection_of_source = the presence or absence of the mechanism was established by reading the pinned source; this is an inspection result, not a test result.

source_refs.description: Source anchors for mitigations whose status was established by reading the pinned source

security_requirements_refs.description: Requirement artifact ids in this corpus that carry the mitigations of this TARA

acceptance_exists.description: Machine-enforced: this corpus holds no accepted residual risk for any record. Any record claiming a real acceptance would be false.

accepted_by.description: Machine-enforced: no person or body has accepted any residual risk in this corpus

statement.description: Plain statement of who would have to accept the residual risk in the hypothetical project, and that no such acceptance exists in reality

assumptions.description: Assumptions this analysis depends on, stated as prose. An assumption that fails invalidates the corresponding threats. Note for consumers: this property holds assumption STATEMENTS, not assumption identifiers. Requirement artifacts carry assumption identifiers in their own 'assumptions' property, defined in requirement.schema.json as an array of assumption IDs; the two properties share a name by design, because both answer 'what does this record assume', but they hold different value types and are validated by different schemas. Neither property $refs the other.

out_of_scope.description: Explicitly excluded from this analysis. Anything listed here has NOT been assessed and must not be assumed safe.
